flagged.title: Glaciated Upland Landscapes & Landforms
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly identifies Helvellyn as a pyramidal peak at 07:04, which would cause a student to lose marks on GCSE questions requiring correct identification or examples of glacial landforms.

mark_affecting.quote: It boasts towering pyramidal peaks like Helvellyn, which stands at an impressive 950 meters

flagged.title: Drought: Causes, Impacts & Responses
flagged.reason: The video states that 600 mm of rain is normal for the Lake District and generous for East Anglia, completely inverting UK rainfall distribution facts where 600 mm in the Lake District would represent an extreme drought.

mark_affecting.quote: Take 600 millimetres of rain, for example. That is totally normal for the Lake District. If you got that same 600 millimetres in East Anglia, it's actually considered generous.

flagged.title: Global & UK Ecosystems
flagged.reason: The video states that tropical forests store more carbon than humans have emitted from fossil fuels since 1850, when they actually store roughly half (250 Gt vs ~485 Gt), teaching a wrong factual comparison that is tested on the lesson flashcard.

mark_affecting.quote: that is literally more carbon than humans have emitted from all fossil fuels combined since the year 1850
